mentions.name: GovWeave
mentions.description: A 'BuiltWith for Government' that tracks all UK government spend and builds a picture of software adoption, showing rising and falling trends of various products across the UK government.
mentions.problem: Government suppliers find it hard to learn what tech and solutions are in place without inside knowledge; opening the data helps more suppliers compete and fosters innovation.
mentions.audience: UK government suppliers and businesses seeking to compete for government contracts
mentions.source_excerpt: It's like a BuiltWith for Government. I am tracking all UK government spend and building a picture of software and rising/falling trends of various products in the government.

evidence.value: It's like a BuiltWith for Government. I am tracking all UK government spend and building a picture of software and rising/falling trends of various products in the government.
